initial_simplification: Mice are very important in brain research because scientists can easily control and study them. Usually, researchers have chosen male mice for experiments instead of female mice. This is partly because they worry that female hormones can change behavior and affect the results of the study.

source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
target_text: Mice are important in brain research because scientists can easily control and study them. In the past, researchers often chose male mice for their experiments instead of female mice because they were worried that female hormones might change the results.
